text_bundle.body:
Hundreds of self employed maternity leave plans and Colorado has the best state program to help you take paid time off.

If you work for yourself in the state of Colorado and are planning a maternity leave this year, you could be entitled to benefits from the state. 

Click below to learn more and get paid to take maternity leave from your business.
